$comment: #52 BLIND ADVERSARIAL PASS — DENY RULES. Inert unless deliberately activated.
This file is NOT .claude/settings.json on purpose. Committing these rules as the project
default would blind every ordinary session, including the ones that need the register
constantly. Activate it only for the duration of the blind pass, then revert.
TO USE: copy this file over .claude/settings.local.json before launching the pass, and
delete that copy afterwards. Verify it took effect by asking the session to read
POST_AUDIT_PLAN.md -- it must be refused. A pass that was never actually denied is worse
than no denial, because it will be believed.
WHY DENIAL RATHER THAN AN INSTRUCTION: every long-lived document in this repository carries
a top-of-file pointer naming FREEZE_CHECKLIST.md and POST_AUDIT_PLAN.md as where current
state lives. That pointer is correct for ordinary readers and is a signpost to the answers
for a blind one. An instruction that does not name these exact paths will be undone by the
first document the pass opens. A deny rule has no such failure mode.
The point is not secrecy. #52 exists to produce the one read of this repository that was
not shaped by the people who built it.
